description.value: Divided in 2306 along a line that had been visible since maturity, and continues under the same name-slot, working the same face. Both halves remember the same childhood and both give the same account of a conversation recorded in 2288, in the same words, which the linguists have found more unsettling than either of them does. Consented to a photograph in 2309, and asked whether the earlier one still counted.
